mentions.name: Veritas - Truth Across Cultures
mentions.description: A non-fiction book cataloguing sayings that recur across many different cultures, based on the idea that multiple cultures independently expressing the same truth lends it credence. It compiles what diverse cultures agree on and is sold exclusively on Amazon through KDP Select.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just finished Veritas - Truth Across Cultures[1]. The idea is that many different cultures have written sayings that are basically the same. Similar to how one would give more credence to more than one person saying the same thing, the same is true for cultures. So, this is like my catalogue of what diverse cultures agree on.
mentions.author: chegra
